raw_response: {"diagnosis": "Batch 14 is a re-delivery: txn_id 904482 appears twice, once with ISO txn_ts from the 02:00 load and once with epoch-millisecond txn_ts (1768716039000 = 2026-01-18 06:00:39 UTC) from the 05:00 load. The fix is to parse epoch-millisecond timestamps and keep one row per txn_id, earliest delivery first.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.6, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN regexp_matches(txn_ts, '^[0-9]+$') THEN CAST(epoch_ms(CAST(txn_ts AS BIGINT)) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts, status FROM (SELECT * FROM raw_transactions QUALIFY row_number() OVER (PARTITION BY txn_id ORDER BY ingest_ts, batch_id) = 1)) WHERE status = 'POSTED';"}}
